q18_store_evidence: All three gold-fact notes EXIST in the frozen conv-26 store: melanie_family_mountain_camping_trip_june_2023, melanie_family_beach_camping, melanie_family_forest_camping_trip_july_2023 (+ melanie_family_forest_camping_late_august_2023).

But NONE is inside the 24-entry recall window: forest-Aug ranks 25th (score 0.2684, TIED with the boundary entries at ranks 15-23; the 0.2684 tie group spans ranks 15-49), forest-July ranks 44th, and the mountain + beach notes are NOT in the top-50 at all.

The baseline answer 'the mountains and the beach' is derived from the cross-reference sentence inside melanie_camping_what_she_loves_most (rank 16): 'This generalizes her earlier camping trips (mountains in June 2023; beach camping as a favorite family activity)'.

'forest' appears NOWHERE in the 24-window recall text - the model cannot answer what it never sees. V's scope verdict (answer-stage set-completeness miss) is corrected: the knowledge gap is read-time; a deep-rank D window/query fix (e.g. maxRecallEntries 24->28+ or a query that differentiates the tied 0.2684 group) is required to restore the forest fact.

G-side: the locomo cat-1 comma_multi_answer scorer splits both prediction and gold on commas and takes the mean over gold sub-answers of the best sub-F1, so a comma-separated answer 'mountains, beach' scores 0.6667 (each gold part matched at F1 1.0) while the same items joined by 'and' score 0.4444 - the answer FORM is a gate-relevant answer-stage factor.
q144_store_evidence: Gold note melanie_son_accident_family_roadtrip_october_2023 is recalled at RANK 0 (score 1.5071) - recall is perfect.
The note supports 'Everyone was freaked out and scared, but thankfully her son is okay' - the baseline answers ('He was okay.' / 'Thankfully, he was okay.') dropped the fear entirely.

The gold's 'reassured by his family' derives from the siblings' sentence ('They were scared but we reassured them', session_18 m_0007) with a they->he swap; the note-faithful son answer caps at 'He was scared but okay' (token-F1 0.6154).
Failure mode: the det answerInstruction's natural-form guidance covers when/what/who/which questions but NOT how-questions, so the model either rambles or answers with the resolution only.
